q: The f-divergence D_f(P||Q) = Σ q(x) f(p(x)/q(x)) (for a convex f with f(1)=0) unifies many divergences. The total variation distance TV(P,Q) = (1/2)Σ|p(x)−q(x)| corresponds to f(t) =
exp: TV distance: f(t) = ½|t−1|. For KL divergence: f(t) = t log t. For Hellinger distance: f(t) = (√t−1)². For χ²-divergence: f(t) = (t−1)². The common f-divergence framework allows unified proofs of data-processing inequalities.
